headline: TEG Overseas Plans Acquisition of Hotel and Events Complex in Tashkent
summary: Uzbekistan-based TEG Overseas intends to acquire a 1,210-room hotel and events complex in Tashkent. The deal would expand the company's hospitality portfolio to include six internationally branded hotels and dedicated conference facilities.
why: TEG Overseas is an integrated hospitality and events company. Expansion in the Central Asian market reflects growing regional investment in tourism and business infrastructure.
